description: Natti & Deacon The Villain (both of CunninLynguists) have joined forces with Sheisty Khrist to form The Off Daze. Psychedelic funk, soul, disco & hip hop rolled up into one. Roller skate music.
credits:
All songs produced by Deacon The Villain except: 
Philly: Co-Produced by Willy Will & Idrys
Emerald City: Co-Produced by Markeith Black & Young L.O.R.D.

Guitar on 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10 by Markeith Black
Horns on 1 by Lance Fury
Horns on 5 by Lance Fury, Ryan Kilgore and Frank Houston Hayes
Horns on 8 & 9 by Micah "XIII" Tatum
Additional vocals on 1, 5, 6 & 10 by Anetra Polk
Additional vocals on 6 & 9 by Carli Bryan
Additional vocals on 8 by Black Angel
Additional vocals on 10 by Jason Coffey
Additional vocals on 7 by Young L.O.R.D.

Executive produced by The Off Daze

Mixed by Steve White for The Dojo Recording Studio
Mastered by Brian "Change" Penney at The Den Digital Studios
Artwork by Ben Wade
